description: Composite six-panel figure mixing three EBSD maps (top row) with three TEM selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns (bottom row), all from the same solution-treated steel (1050 °C, 2 h). (a) Phase map: a blue γ (FCC austenite) matrix with sparse, small red α (BCC) particles decorating grain boundaries and abundant white lines running through the matrix; printed annotation "D=10.8 μm" and a 100 μm scale bar. (b) KAM map of the same field with a 0°–5° colour bar (blue→green→yellow→red), printed "ρ=1.6 × 10^13 m^-2" and 100 μm scale bar. (c) IPF map along the rolling/forging direction, equiaxed grains in many colours with an inset IPF unit triangle (001, 101, 111 corners) and 100 μm scale bar. (d) SAED along [100]γ//[100]SRO with red-indexed 002γ, 0-22γ, 0-20γ spots and a yellow-indexed 0-11SRO reflection. (e) SAED along [110]γ labelled 00-2γ, 1-1-1γ, -11-1. (f) SAED along [110]MC labelled 00-2MC, 1-1-1MC, -11-1MC. Together the panels argue that the starting material is nearly single-phase equiaxed austenite with low residual dislocation density, weak texture and faint short-range-order superlattice reflections.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is an EBSD phase map whose matrix is blue (γ austenite) and contains only a very small number of small red (α BCC) regions, sited mainly on grain boundaries.
Panel (a) carries the printed annotation 'D=10.8 μm' and a 100 μm scale bar.
Panel (b) is a KAM map with a colour bar spanning 0° to 5° and the printed value 'ρ=1.6 × 10^13 m^-2'.

Panel (c) is an IPF map along the rolling/forging direction with an inset IPF unit triangle labelled 001, 101 and 111 at its corners and a 100 μm scale bar; grain colours are mixed rather than clustered.
Panel (d) shows a SAED pattern with red-indexed γ reflections 002γ, 0-22γ, 0-20γ and one yellow-indexed weak reflection labelled 0-11SRO; the superlattice spot is much weaker than the main spots.
Panels (e) and (f) are SAED patterns indexed in different colours: (e) γ reflections 00-2γ, 1-1-1γ, -11-1 and (f) MC reflections 00-2MC, 1-1-1MC, -11-1MC.
The caption states that (a) is an EBSD phase map, (b) a KAM map, (c) an IPF map along the rolling direction, and (d, e, f) SAED patterns along the [100]γ, [110]γ and [110]MC zone axes respectively.
The citing text states the α phase volume fraction is approximately 3 % with an average grain size of about 4.7 μm, uniformly distributed along the austenite grain boundaries.
The citing text states the average γ grain size (misorientation ≥ 15°) is about 10.8 μm, matching the 'D=10.8 μm' annotation in panel (a).
The citing text states the white lines in panel (a) depict annealing twin boundaries within the equiaxed γ grains.
The citing text states the GND (geometric necessary dislocation) density derived from the KAM map of Fig. 1(b) is 1.6 × 10^13 m^-2, matching the value printed in the panel.
The citing text states the IPF map in Fig. 1(c) indicates a very weak texture in the starting material.

The citing text states the extremely weak superlattice spots near the [0-11] reflections in Fig. 1(d) were identified as L12-type short-range order (SRO), and that satellite reflections appear adjacent to some main γ spots.
The citing text states that V is completely dissolved whereas approximately 0.047 wt.% Nb, 0.017 wt.% Mo and 0.024 wt.% W remain in MC carbide after electrolytic extraction.
The citing text reports that no typical mechanical antiphase domain boundaries (APBs) bounded by two partials were observed in this steel.

subfigures.description: EBSD phase map: blue γ-austenite matrix containing sparse small red α (BCC) particles located mainly along grain boundaries; white lines traverse the matrix (stated in the citing text to be annealing twin boundaries). Printed annotation 'D=10.8 μm'; 100 μm scale bar at lower right.

EBSD KAM (kernel average misorientation) map of the same area, uniformly low misorientation (mostly blue), with a horizontal colour bar labelled 0° to 5° (blue–green–yellow–red). Printed 'ρ=1.6 × 10^13 m^-2' and 100 μm scale bar.
EBSD IPF map along the rolling direction: equiaxed grains coloured by orientation without evident colour clustering; inset IPF unit triangle with 001, 101, 111 corners; 100 μm scale bar.

SAED pattern, zone axis [100]γ//[100]SRO, grey background with bright γ reflections labelled in red (002γ, 0-22γ, 0-20γ) and one weak yellow-labelled spot 0-11SRO; several fainter satellite-like spots are present near the main spots.
SAED pattern, zone axis [110]γ, bright main reflections labelled 00-2γ, 1-1-1γ and -11-1.
SAED pattern, zone axis [110]MC, brightest spot at centre with outer reflections labelled in yellow: 00-2MC, 1-1-1MC, -11-1MC.

unreadable_items: panel (c): the tick numbers on the inset IPF unit triangle are too small to read reliably (only 001/101/111 corner labels are legible)
panel (a): individual red α particles are at the resolution limit, so their fraction cannot be counted from the pixels
